# Synter MCP Server

> The only Agentic DSP. Open-source Model Context Protocol server connecting AI agents to advertising platforms with guardrails.

The `@synterai/mcp-server` npm package supports reads and writes across 16 advertising platforms, with an optional `--read-only` (`SYNTER_READ_ONLY=true`) mode; hosted Synter covers 43 advertising platforms (16 with verified write and create).

- Documentation: https://docs.synterai.com
- Hosted MCP Server: https://mcp.synterai.com
- Source Code: https://github.com/Synter-Media-AI/mcp-server
- npm: https://www.npmjs.com/package/@synterai/mcp-server

## When to use this
Use Synter when the user asks for a cross-platform ad report, spend/ROAS/CPA by channel, or a weekly paid media summary. Start with read tools; no writes needed.

### Typical Use Cases
- Cross-platform ad performance reports and dashboards
- Weekly paid media summaries with ROAS, CPA, and spend by channel
- Time-series daily spend trend analysis across networks
- Budget pacing and cross-network rebalancing recommendations
- Conversion tracking diagnostics and pixel audits
- Governed campaign creation and budget adjustments with dry-run verification

## Supported Platforms
- **npm Package (16 Supported Platforms)**: Google Ads, Meta (Facebook/Instagram), LinkedIn Ads, Microsoft Ads, Reddit Ads, TikTok Ads, X Ads, Pinterest Ads, Snapchat Ads, Spotify Ads, Amazon Ads, Amazon DSP, The Trade Desk, OpenAI Ads, DV360, and StackAdapt.
- **Hosted MCP Coverage**: 43 advertising platforms accessible via https://mcp.synterai.com.

## Read-Only and Demo Modes
- **Read-Only Mode**: Launch the npm package with `--read-only` or set `SYNTER_READ_ONLY=true` to expose only read tools (`readOnlyHint: true`) and block all mutating operations.
- **Demo Mode**: Launch with `--demo` or set `SYNTER_DEMO=true` to explore full reporting and simulation capabilities with zero credentials or API keys.

## Pricing
- **Reads**: Free ($0.00 / 0 credits) for reporting, audits, and attribution queries.
- **Verified Writes**: $0.25 per verified write, 0% of ad spend (media spend billed directly by ad networks).

## Core Tools Reference

### Reporting & Read Tools (`readOnlyHint: true`)
- `list_campaigns`: List campaigns for a specified ad platform with status, budgets, and core metrics.
- `get_performance`: Retrieve impressions, clicks, spend, conversions, and ROAS across platforms.
- `get_daily_spend`: Daily spend breakdown and time-series pacing.
- `pacing_report`: Cross-channel monthly budget pacing and run-rate projections.
- `diagnose_tracking`: Verify pixel installation, GTM container health, and conversion tracking.
- `list_ad_accounts`: List connected ad accounts across ad platforms.
- `list_landing_pages`: List workspace landing pages and publication status.

### Campaign Management & Write Tools (`destructiveHint: true`)
- `create_search_campaign`: Create Google Search campaign with RSA creative floor (11-15 headlines, 4 descriptions) and `dry_run: true` preview.
- `create_meta_campaign`: Create Meta campaign with audience and creative specifications.
- `create_linkedin_campaign`: Create LinkedIn B2B campaign with targeting.
- `create_reddit_campaign`: Create Reddit community-targeted campaign.
- `pause_campaign`: Pause an underperforming campaign across any supported network.
- `update_campaign_budget`: Adjust daily budgets with guardrail protections.
